source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 1296 adds non-null release assertions for folder, listener and channel, a main-thread callback requirement and a one-start flag. It also checks m_channelListener after SetupPartExtractorListener, because that call may replace it. Preserve the check after the replacing call in this path. These assertions do not prove duplicate stop callbacks are supported; no such guard is added. This is scoped defensive-source guidance, not a general rule to replace recoverable errors with release assertions. No assertion or thread test was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Offline stream listener assertions define required construction and callback state
